sources.title: Teradata/gte-base-en-v1.5 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: An Embedding Model which maps text (sentence/ paragraphs) into a vector. The Alibaba-NLP/gte-base-en-v1.5 model well known for its effectiveness in capturing semantic meanings in text data.

sources.title: gte-base-en-v1.5: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview gte-base-en-v1.5 is a 137-million parameter English text embedding model developed by Alibaba-NLP that generates 768-dimensional dense vectors for semantic search, clustering, and similarity matching. Built on a transformer++ architecture (BERT + RoPE + GLU) backbone, this model supports a context length of 8192 tokens, making it substantially more capable than prior embedding models ...

sources.title: gte-base-en-v1.5: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Use gte-base-en-v1.5 for English-only applications where you need a smaller model footprint (137M vs 560M) and long-context support; use E5 if multilingual requirements justify the 4x parameter increase.
